title: Store listing, icons, privacy policy and terms pages from site config
description: The generator adds publishingInformation and privacyAndCompliance to skill.json. Add clean /privacy-alexa (or extend the existing privacy page) and terms pages on the site. Gherkin: the pages render and the manifest URLs resolve.

comments.text: Done: privacy and terms pages at /alexa/privacy/ and /alexa/terms/ in AnthusAI/Papyrus#943, and the listing fields in the sync. The pages appear on a site at its next projection. Real store icons are a separate M5 task; Pilobolus has placeholder icons.
